topic: The surgeon who operated on himself and found something inside he couldn't explain
hook: He operated on himself — and found something unexplainable inside.
script: He operated on himself — and found something unexplainable inside. In 1921, Dr Evan O'Neill Kane performed an appendectomy on himself under local anaesthetic to prove the procedure was safe. Inside, he found an abnormality that no prior X-ray had detected — a tissue formation his colleagues called anatomically impossible. He survived the operation. He never publicly explained what he found. His private notes were sealed until 1989. Follow for real medical mysteries that science still can't categorise.
